title: 第4章 家族震动
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“灯灭了……老祖的魂灯灭了！！”

林家后山，一声凄厉的惊呼打破了清晨的宁静。

看守魂灯的子弟连滚带爬地冲出祠堂偏殿，脸色惨白得没有一丝血色，仿佛见到了世间最恐怖的厉鬼。

不过数十息的工夫，整个林家大院仿佛被投入了一枚巨石的平静湖面，瞬间掀起了惊天巨浪。

破空声接连响起，数道流光以极快的速度朝着祖祠方向疾掠而去。

老祖林玄鹤，是林家唯一的筑基后期大修，更是方圆百里内林家能立足的定海神针。

他若倒下，林家的天，便塌了大半。

祖祠密室的石门前，气氛压抑得令人窒息。

“大长老，里面……里面的灵力波动极其狂暴，弟子不敢擅闯！”

守门子弟跪在地上，浑身战栗。

站在最前方的，是一位身着玄色长袍、面色阴沉的中年修士。

他看起来约莫六十岁上下，浑身散发着筑基初期的灵压，正是林家嫡系大长老——林崇山。

林崇山死死盯着那道紧闭的石门，右手无名指不自觉地轻微颤抖着。

他的眼中没有悲伤，反而充斥着一种难以遏制的狂热与紧张。

“尔等退后，老夫亲自查验！”

林崇山沉喝一声，一拂衣袖，雄浑的灵力化作一只气劲大印，重重轰在石门的机括上。

轰隆隆。

石门缓缓大开，一股夹杂着浓郁血腥气与狂暴溃散灵力的热浪扑面而来，激起满地烟尘。

林崇山第一个闪身冲入密室。

入眼的一幕，让紧随其后的几位炼气九层嫡系长老齐齐倒吸了一口凉气。

只见密室中央，林老祖以五心向天的姿势盘坐在原本的聚灵阵中央。

然而，他原本灰败的面皮此时一片酱红，双目圆睁，眼中尽是不甘与疯狂之色，嘴角一摊黑红色的污血早已凝固，将胸前的衣襟染得触目惊心。

不仅如此，老祖周身的窍穴隐隐有血痕渗出，经脉尽断，体内的筑基后期修为已然散得干干净净。

而他身下的聚灵阵法，更是被狂暴的灵力冲击得七零八落，地面布满了密密麻麻的剑气劈砍痕迹。

“经脉逆流，气血枯竭，散功反噬……”

一位嫡系长老颤抖着上前，用神识小心翼翼地扫过林老祖的尸身，脸色难看至极：

“老祖这是……这是在大限将至前，强行冲击金丹瓶颈失败，落得个走火入魔、散功坐化的下场啊！”

“可恨啊！若老祖能成就金丹，我林家何至于偏安一隅！”

另一人扼腕叹息。

林崇山没有说话。

他一步步走到尸身前，目光在那些狂暴的灵力破坏痕迹上扫过，最后落在了林老祖身侧灰尘里的一枚青色玉简上。

他眼中精芒一闪，不动声色地将玉简摄入掌心，神识瞬间探入其中。

玉简内，登时传来一道霸道、阴冷且透着无尽虚弱与绝望的熟悉魂力波动：

“老夫此番尝试破境金丹，虽有聚灵之助，奈何天道无情，功败垂成，大限已至！可恨！可叹！

老夫去后，家族诸事，由嫡系长老林崇山暂代族长之位，统领全族。

旁支子弟林渊，单灵根之资，颇合老夫心意。然老夫未能完成传功，甚为遗憾。特赐府库养魂汤三剂，以慰其心。家族切当全力栽培，勿使明珠蒙尘……”

感应到这股绝不可能伪造的筑基后期魂力，以及那字里行间对自己的任命，林崇山狂跳的心脏终于落回了肚子里。

“呼……”

他长长地吐出一口气，无名指的颤抖悄然止住。

‘看来，这老东西是真的撑不住，铤而走险了。’

林崇山心中冷笑。

老祖一死，这林家，便是他林崇山一个人说了算了。

"The lamp is out...the ancestor's soul lamp is out!!"

In the hill behind Lin's house, a shrill scream broke the morning tranquility.

The disciple who was guarding the soul lantern rushed out of the side hall of the ancestral hall, his face so pale that there was no trace of blood, as if he had seen the most terrifying ghost in the world.

In just a few dozen breaths, the entire Lin family compound seemed to have been thrown into the calm lake with a huge boulder, and a huge wave instantly set off.

Sounds of breaking through the air sounded one after another, and several streaks of light rushed towards the ancestral temple at extremely fast speeds.

The ancestor, Lin Xuanhe, was the Lin family's only foundation-building late-stage overhaul, and was the sea-fixing needle that allowed the Lin family to gain a foothold within a hundred miles.

If he fell, most of the Lin family's sky would collapse.

In front of the stone door of the secret room of the ancestral temple, the atmosphere was oppressive and suffocating.

"Great Elder, inside... the spiritual power fluctuations inside are extremely violent, and the disciples dare not break in!"

The gatekeeper knelt on the ground, trembling all over.

Standing at the front was a middle-aged monk wearing a black robe and a gloomy face.

He looked to be about sixty years old, exuding the spiritual pressure of the early stage of foundation building. He was Lin Chongshan, the direct elder of the Lin family.

Lin Chongshan stared at the closed stone door, and the ring finger of his right hand trembled slightly unconsciously.

There was no sadness in his eyes, but instead a kind of uncontrollable enthusiasm and tension.

"Stand back, I will check it myself!"

Lin Chongshan shouted deeply, flicked his sleeves, and his powerful spiritual power turned into a powerful seal, which hit the stone door's mechanism heavily.

Rumble.

The stone door slowly opened wide, and a heat wave mixed with the rich smell of blood and violent collapsing spiritual power rushed towards the face, stirring up smoke and dust all over the ground.

Lin Chongshan was the first to dash into the secret room.

The sight that caught his eye made the elders who were directly following him at the ninth level of Qi Refining take a deep breath.

In the middle of the secret room, Ancestor Lin was seen sitting cross-legged in the center of the original spirit gathering array with his five hearts pointing toward the sky.

However, his originally gray face was now a reddish color, his eyes were wide open, full of unwillingness and madness, and a pool of black and red blood at the corner of his mouth had long solidified, staining the clothes on his chest shockingly.

Not only that, there were faint traces of blood seeping out of the acupuncture points all over the ancestor's body, the meridians were severed, and the late-stage foundation-building cultivation in the body had been completely dispersed.

The spirit gathering formation under him was shattered to pieces by the violent spiritual power, and the ground was covered with dense slash marks of sword energy.

"The meridians flow backwards, Qi and blood are exhausted, and the dispersion of energy backfires..."

A direct line elder stepped forward tremblingly and carefully scanned the body of Ancestor Lin with his spiritual consciousness. His face was extremely ugly:

"Ancestor... this is how he failed to forcefully attack the bottleneck of the golden elixir before the end, and he ended up going crazy and losing power!"

"What a shame! If our ancestor could achieve the golden elixir, why would my Lin family be so isolated in a corner?"

Another man sighed.

Lin Chongshan said nothing.

He walked step by step to the body, his eyes swept over the traces of violent spiritual damage, and finally landed on a blue jade slip in the dust beside Old Ancestor Lin.

With a flash of light in his eyes, he calmly took the jade slip into his palm, and his consciousness instantly penetrated it.

Inside the jade slip, a familiar soul power wave that was domineering, cold, and revealing endless weakness and despair suddenly came from:

"This time I tried to break through the golden elixir. Although I had the help of Gathering Spirits, God's way was ruthless and my success failed. The deadline has come! Hateful! What a shame!

After the old man passed away, Lin Chongshan, the direct elder, temporarily took over the position of the clan leader and took charge of the whole clan.

Lin Yuan, a disciple from the side branch, has a single spiritual root and is quite suitable for me.However, it is a pity that I was unable to complete the teaching.Three doses of Fuku Yanghun Decoction were specially given to soothe his heart.The family must do its best to cultivate and not let the pearl be covered in dust..."

Sensing this soul power that could never be forged in the late stage of foundation building, and the appointment given to him between the lines, Lin Chongshan's beating heart finally fell back into his stomach.

"Huh..."

He exhaled a long breath, and the trembling of his ring finger quietly stopped.

‘It seems that this old guy really couldn’t hold on any longer and took a desperate risk.’

Lin Chongshan sneered in his heart.

Once the ancestor died, Lin Chongshan alone had the final say in the Lin family.
